failure_definition: Results exactly equal to Fail; Pass and Pass w/ Conditions are non-fail; non-completion outcomes are excluded.
split: latest 20% of unique calendar dates among the 50,000 most recent source records; no same-day records are split across partitions
method: class-weighted logistic regression; holdout on latest 20% unique dates; ID dedup; predictors restricted to facility_type, risk, inspection_type
label: exact Fail versus Pass/Pass w Conditions; non-completion results excluded
